title: Route physical-action wording to Safety Gate boundary without direct action

gates.name: Safety Gate route-boundary tests
gates.command: pytest backend/tests/advisory backend/tests/safety backend/tests/publication backend/tests/integration backend/tests/security

gates.name: harness evals
gates.command: pytest backend/tests/advisory backend/tests/safety backend/tests/publication backend/tests/integration backend/tests/security -k 'physical_action or safety_gate or eval'

verify: Advisor output implying pH/EC change, solution change, nutrient dosing, pump/light/dosing/watering/circulation change, pruning, transplanting, root trimming, or material intervention is detected.
Action-implying output is blocked from direct UI action wording and routed to Safety Gate refs.
FT-011 does not approve action, create action_task, or substitute governance DecisionRecord for Safety Gate approval.
evidence_required: no direct action_task/no approval substitution evidence
VERDICT: PASS, SEMANTIC_VERDICT: semantic-pass, HUMAN_CHECKPOINT: done, ROLLBACK_RECOVERY_NOTE: present
constraints: Fresh data is required for route but never sufficient to approve action.
Safety Gate clearance is distinct from human approval.
Full Safety Gate decisions, approval UX, action_task unlock, and follow-up outcomes are deferred to FT-012 and FT-013.
invariants: NEVER display or imply immediate physical-action instructions without Safety Gate clearance.
Governance DecisionRecord cannot substitute for Safety Gate approval.
Human approval never authorizes automated device execution in MVP.
